title: How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors
snippet: One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30.
citation: How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors. arxiv.org, 2026-11-09. https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12820v1
